Refitting

Removing

- Check that the door inner panel is not damaged.

- Attach the handle assembly to the panel.

- Connect the electrical connections.

- Place the panel in position and attach the inner glass scraper to the door frame, then attach the inner retainers.

- Tighten the panel fixing bolts.

- Fit the trim cover.
